newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia bulls toss Helsinki bourse near year-high.
newsitem.headline: Nokia bulls toss Helsinki bourse near year-high.

text.p: Finnish shares on Monday were boosted by strong gains in telecoms major Nokia which found lively demand in the afternoon on hopes for a strong January-September earnings report this week, brokers said.
The HEX rose 0.63 percent to 2259.0, less than ten points off its 2268.3 peak for the year, set on October 18. Volume was fair at 347 million markka.
"Expectations are quite high," one broker said, referring to Nokia which is due to report nine-month results on Thursday, November 14.
Nokia surged 7.50 markka to close at a new 232.00 markka calendar year high. It accounted for over half of volume which was otherwise subdued as U.S. treasury markets were closed for Veterans Day.

The median of analysts' forecasts for Nokia was for a 2.2 billion markka profit before tax, down from 3.98 billion in the same period last year, but signalling a recovery compared to the 1.13 billion first-half result, brokers said.
Benefon, another Finnish mobile phone maker, closed up 4.50 markka or over five percent at 89.00. Brokers said it was rising in Nokia's wake.
Nokia was expected to continuing setting the tone this week, along with the U.S. Federal Reserve's open market committee meeting and U.S. producers price data due on Wednesday.
Engineering group Rauma rose on a $35 million order from Thailand and closed up 2.00 at 85.50 markka.
Cranemaker Konecranes also made the top advancers' list with a five markka rise to 135.00 markka after buying the crane operations of German MAN GHH Logistics.
Banking group Merita's A share closed unchanged at 13.90 but the preferential B share increased its premium by rising 0.30 to 15.80 markka on dividend hopes.
Merita last week said it aims to pay dividends on both shares out of 1996 earnings -- it would be the first payout in five years.
Forestries were soft, with UPM-Kymmene falling one markka to 87.00, Enso dropping 0.50 to 34.00 and Metsa-Serla also shedding 0.50 to end at 29.50 markka.
